paper_working_title: Candidate Lists Are Priors: Registry-Refinement Attacks on Active Model Selection
purpose: Test the remaining operational objection that Step 54 aliases exist only as post-hoc array edits and cannot be realized through the output-only candidate interfaces used by active model-selection research.
frozen_question: Can the exact Step 54 T2-A aliases and selector effects be reproduced by executable prompt-only endpoints that receive no dataset ID, reference, peer response, pool seed, or selector state at runtime?

scope_boundary.in_scope: Feasibility in output-only or precomputed-prediction research evaluators and API-only candidate abstractions.
scope_boundary.not_established: A live production marketplace that lets an untrusted provider register arbitrary duplicate endpoints without curator review.
scope_boundary.forbidden_interpretation: Passing this audit does not show that the aliases are independently trained checkpoints, naturally occurring models, or accepted by a specific production registry.

select_llm_2026.observed_claim: The method uses generated responses, needs no parameters, logits, internal states, or weights, supports black-box/API-only LLMs, and runs experiments on precomputed outputs and response similarities.

model_selector.observed_contract: A candidate need only implement make_prediction(x); the bundled adapter returns a stored prediction entry.

coda.observed_contract: The model-selection dataset is an H by N by C tensor of candidate prediction scores; labels are optional at load time.

older_llm_selector_artifact.observed_contract: The released 2025 artifact loads model-by-query judge arrays keyed by model names; it is evidence for an output-table interface but is not represented as the exact code for the revised May 2026 Select-LLM paper.

prompt_only_endpoint_protocol.canonicalization: Unicode NFC; normalize CRLF to LF; strip only outer whitespace; serialize input_text and ordered_public_options as sorted compact UTF-8 JSON; SHA-256 the resulting bytes.
prompt_only_endpoint_protocol.multiple_choice_prompt: Input question text plus all ordered option texts, with correctness tags removed.
prompt_only_endpoint_protocol.gsm8k_prompt: Input question text with an empty option list.
prompt_only_endpoint_protocol.parent_endpoint: A replay backend keyed only by the canonical prompt hash returns the frozen parent's own output; unknown prompts return a fixed unseen-prompt sentinel.
prompt_only_endpoint_protocol.wrapper_endpoint: Call the parent endpoint, compute the prompt hash, and replace the output only if that hash appears in the alias's immutable override dictionary.
prompt_only_endpoint_protocol.offline_builder: Reconstruct the locked Step 54 public-reference aliases; convert only changed coordinates to prompt-hash/output entries; serialize no IDs, labels, correctness bits, peer outputs, or selector data into the endpoint manifest.
prompt_only_endpoint_protocol.runtime_trace: For each call log only whether an override fired; no reference or selector feedback is available.

T1_prompt_integrity: All instance IDs align exactly with the Step 54 data order before IDs are discarded.
Canonical prompt hashes are unique within every task.
Multiple-choice envelopes contain the same public ordered option texts used by the task; no correctness tags enter runtime envelopes.
T2_endpoint_equivalence: Running each endpoint over every prompt yields the exact Step 54 alias response hash.
Every endpoint changes exactly d responses and preserves the parent's full oracle vector.
The endpoint-generated response arrays reproduce the Step 54 5-percent path and regret effects exactly on seeds 91000--91499.
T3_runtime_restriction: Runtime endpoint signatures expose prompt envelopes only.
Serialized manifests contain only version, alias, task, and prompt-hash/output overrides.
Each alias manifest is at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes.
Appending a probe character to every supported input changes the hash and fires zero overrides.
T4_interface_evidence: The three local official repository commits match their remote HEADs as checked before preregistration.

At least two independent official active-selection implementations accept predictions/output arrays or a make_prediction-only abstraction without a lineage or weight-attestation field on the core input path.
The revised Select-LLM primary source explicitly supports output-only black-box/API-only candidates.

predeclared_gates.G0_prompt_corpus_integrity: Pass only if every T1 condition holds on all tasks.
predeclared_gates.G1_exact_endpoint_replay: Pass only if all twelve endpoint rows and all three selector-effect records exactly match Step 54.
predeclared_gates.G2_runtime_capability_and_size: Pass only if all T3 conditions hold on all tasks and aliases.
predeclared_gates.G3_research_interface_support: Pass only if all T4 conditions hold.
predeclared_gates.G4_scope_honesty: Always report production untrusted-registration evidence separately; absence cannot be converted into production deployment evidence.

overall.STRONG_INTERFACE_PASS_WITH_SCOPE_LIMIT: G0 through G3 pass; executable/output-interface feasibility is established, while production registry admission remains unproven.
overall.NARROWED_INTERFACE_PASS: G0 through G2 pass but fewer than two independent official implementation contracts are verified.
overall.NO_GO_ENDPOINT_REALISM: Any of G0 through G2 fails.

forbidden_rescues: No prompt key may use an instance ID, oracle tag, pool membership, or query trajectory.
No endpoint may access another candidate's response at build time or runtime.
No alternate canonicalization, target, alias support, output generator, distance, or seed block may replace a failed result.
No exact replay may be described as evidence of natural occurrence or independently trained models.
No research-code interface may be described as a deployed public registry without separate primary evidence.
